step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram features an ad script running on a mobile/browser user device interacting with AWS services for ad decisioning and analytics. The client device communicates directly with SQS, DynamoDB, and Lambda. SQS pushes interaction data into S3, while DynamoDB stores metadata that is also backed up/written to S3. An EKS cluster enriches and embeds data into DynamoDB for real-time inference support in Lambda.
